rationale_zh: 本次提交修改解压器内部 Huffman 树的初始化：改为按当前树类型清零整棵树（tinfl_clear_tree），以消除未初始化读取，属于对象初始化（lifecycle）方面的改动，且位于 uncompress() → tinfl_decompress() 这条 harness 每次都会走的路径上。harness 只调用 uncompress() 并释放缓冲区，不接触内部结构：变更前后都能编译，回放语料无新崩溃，新增的清零函数被执行。harness 仍然充分，属于显式 lifecycle 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit changes how the decompressor initialises its internal Huffman trees, clearing the whole tree for the current type (tinfl_clear_tree) to avoid uninitialised reads: an object-initialisation (lifecycle) change on the uncompress() -> tinfl_decompress() path the harness takes on every input. The harness only calls uncompress() and frees its buffer, never touching internal structures: it builds before and after, replay shows no new crash, and the new clearing function runs. The harness stays adequate: explicit lifecycle negative.
